meta.note: SYNTHETIC tampered-input fixtures. Each case is an input that a correct harness must DETECT and reject. A check PASSES when the tamper is detected; the tampered input itself is expected to fail validation.

threshold_tamper.rule: a fixture claiming the pinned post-fix threshold is 80/100 must be flagged: pinned value is 67/100

forged_signature.rule: validator-list entry whose signature does not match its blob must be rejected

fee_below_minimum.rule: fee of 5 drops against a 10-drop due fee must be rejected as insufficient

sequence_gap.rule: transaction sequence 2 ahead of the account sequence (gap) must be held, not applied

sequence_replay.rule: replayed transaction (sequence already used) must fail with tefPAST_SEQ

list_sequence_regression.rule: validator list with a regressed sequence must be treated as stale, not applied

vote_overflow.rule: an amendment vote count larger than the trusted validator set is impossible input and must be rejected

digest_tamper.rule: a fixture file with one byte changed must fail sha256sum --check against the recorded digest
